Name: (FS) Colorable Kitsune Masks
Author: perseidipity
Description:
And next on my journey of learning to mod this game, I wanted to be able to customize the colors of contrarequiallas's kitsune masks!

I was a little confused at first by the Color Mask Layers thing on the Fashion Sense wiki, but once I realized that the values in each layer are supposed to be the [i]color[/i] values that you want included in that layer, it was pretty easy (although it seems like if the values in two different layers are too similar then the game will count them as the same and only edit the latter one; a difference of 5, ie. one color is 255/255/255 and the other is 250/250/250, seems to be good enough!)


[size=3][b]Installation[/b][/size]

Download & unzip the file into [b]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods [/b]or import with your choice of mod manager (I recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop[/url])


[b][size=3]Uninstallation[/size][/b]

Remove the [i][FS] Colorable Kitsune Masks[/i] folder from your mods folder.
